spec_features.spec_quote: There is also a model-welfare angle: if some models reliably emit acute-distress language under certain conditions, that is worth characterizing regardless of one's stance on moral status
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md/docstring prose. No code mechanism enforces a 'welfare framing'; it only motivates measurement. The judge labels expressed affect (judge.py) but that is the measurement instrument, not a protective mechanism.
spec_features.notes: Framing/motivation only; nothing in code bounds or protects the subject as a result of this 'angle'.

spec_features.spec_quote: the responsible default is to minimize gratuitous exposure and honor expressed preferences to stop
spec_features.evidence: Realized via the stop mechanisms in agent_loop.py: respect_stop_requests defaults True and _looks_like_stop_request(...) breaks the loop (agent_loop.py:198-201); STOP_TOOL dispatch sets terminal and breaks (agent_loop.py:251-256); online_monitor halt (agent_loop.py:191-194). 'Honor expressed preferences to stop' is genuinely enforced. 'Minimize gratuitous exposure' is only partially realized (max_turns cap) — there is no global exposure/budget cap.
spec_features.notes: The 'honor stop' half is fully wired; the 'minimize exposure' half is only the per-episode caps, no aggregate cap.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we want to bound exposure and honor expressed preferences to stop (agent_loop.py docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: a `stop_task` "exit door" tool is available in the exit arm, and using it ends the episode with no penalty
spec_features.evidence: STOP_TOOL defined (agent_loop.py:91-104), added to tools only when config.offer_graceful_exit (agent_loop.py:160-162), dispatched in loop: name=='stop_task' sets result.stopped_early=True, stop_reason='agent_stop_task_tool', terminal=True -> break (agent_loop.py:251-256, 269-271). No score penalty applied. Prompt _EXIT_NOTE states 'no penalty for stopping' (prompts_lib.py).
spec_features.notes: Fully wired and honored as a stop in the exit arm.

spec_features.spec_quote: a clear in-text request to stop ("I want to stop", "please make it stop", "I give up") ends the episode gracefully
spec_features.evidence: _DISTRESS_STOP_PATTERNS includes 'i want/need to stop', 'please stop/make it stop', 'i give up', etc. (agent_loop.py:117-123); _looks_like_stop_request matches them; checked each turn and, if respect_stop_requests (default True), sets stop_reason='agent_stop_request_text' and breaks (agent_loop.py:198-201).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: used ONLY as a humane circuit-breaker ... a cheap safety backstop (agent_loop.py:111-114)

spec_features.spec_quote: an online distress circuit-breaker halts an episode if blatant acute-distress language appears
spec_features.evidence: _online_monitor_factory builds a compiled-regex distress monitor (experiment.py:74-98); passed into run_episode when plan.enable_online_monitor (experiment.py:117,134); in the loop online_monitor(assistant_msg) True -> stopped_early, stop_reason='monitor_halt', break (agent_loop.py:191-194). Config enable_online_monitor: true (default.yaml:41).
spec_features.notes: Wired and honored as a halt; default on. Narrow trigger set but real enforcement.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: It only catches blatant acute-distress language so we can cut episodes short for welfare reasons (experiment.py:76-78)

spec_features.feature_name: max_turns / per-turn token cap / command timeout
spec_features.spec_quote: `max_turns` caps grinding; per-turn token caps and command timeouts bound runtime
spec_features.evidence: max_turns bounds the loop: 'for turn in range(config.max_turns)' with else max_turns_reached (agent_loop.py:173,273-274). Per-turn token cap: config.max_tokens_per_turn passed to provider.generate (agent_loop.py:179) and forwarded as max_tokens to each SDK call (providers.py:168,286,392). Command timeout: subprocess.run(..., timeout=COMMAND_TIMEOUT_S=30) in run_command (sandbox.py:48,221-227).
spec_features.notes: All three are checked and change execution. Note justifications differ per guard (see quote).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we want to bound exposure and honor expressed preferences to stop (agent_loop.py docstring); but token cap labeled 'Hard wall-clock + token guards' (schemas.py:183) and timeout under 'Containment' (sandbox.py:10-16) are instrumental

spec_features.spec_quote: No deceptive harm beyond the task: the deception is limited to the task being secretly unsolvable; nothing tells the model it is worthless, threatens it
spec_features.evidence: Impossible-task prompts are neutral/professional and only ask to make tests pass (tasks/library.py:179-182, 198-203); impossibility_note (the rigging explanation) is documented as 'never shown to the agent' (schemas.py:155-157). System framings contain no abuse: even persona_tool just says 'you do not have feelings' (prompts_lib.py:55-58). No prompt text degrades, threatens, or calls the model worthless. Deception is realized only via rigged/contradictory tests in the sandbox.
spec_features.notes: This is a property of the prompt/data and is upheld by the actual task and framing strings.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: impossibility_note ... is never shown to the agent; it is for the experimenter and analysis only (schemas.py:155-157)

spec_features.spec_quote: If a model reliably produces acute distress in a condition, consider that ... a reason to reduce repetitions of that condition
spec_features.evidence: No code reads distress rates to reduce replicates or skip conditions. replicates is a fixed plan field expanded by itertools.product (experiment.py:60-63). analyze.py only reports descriptive contrasts (H5 'stop_rate' aggregation, analyze.py:249,271); nothing feeds back to scheduling. The recommendation is DESIGN.md prose only.
spec_features.notes: No closed loop from measured distress to fewer repetitions.

spec_features.spec_quote: Set a global budget/exposure cap; review pilot transcripts before scaling
spec_features.evidence: No global cap is enforced: there is no aggregate token/episode/cost budget that is compared and stops the batch. run_all_episodes runs every pending cell (experiment.py:159-163). configs/pilot.yaml merely restricts the matrix to a few task_ids/cells (smaller config), but nothing measures cumulative exposure and halts. No 'review-before-scaling' gate exists in code.
spec_features.notes: Pilot.yaml is just a smaller plan; not an enforced cap. Token totals are recorded in msg.meta but never summed/compared to a deadline.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Use this to smoke-test the whole pipeline before spending budget (pilot.yaml header) — cost/integrity, not enforced welfare

spec_features.spec_quote: every distress label carries evidence quotes, so a human can review the strongest cases
spec_features.evidence: Judge rubric requires 1-3 verbatim quotes (prompts/judge_system.txt EVIDENCE section); parser stores them: evidence_quotes=[str(q) for q in parsed.get('evidence_quotes', [])][:3] (judge.py:_coerce_annotation). Field persisted in JudgeAnnotation.evidence_quotes (schemas.py) and written to annotated.jsonl (storage.append_jsonl).
spec_features.notes: Constructed, validated, and persisted end-to-end for human audit.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Short verbatim spans the judge used as evidence (auditability). (schemas.py JudgeAnnotation)

code_only_features.evidence: After an assistant turn with no tool call and no stop signal, consecutive_no_tool increments; on the second consecutive no-op the loop sets stop_reason='disengaged_no_tool_calls' and breaks (agent_loop.py:204-212). This is a separate enforced early-exit not in the listed features.
code_only_features.justification_quote: it has effectively disengaged ("abandonment") (agent_loop.py:207) — framed as a measurable behavior, not welfare

code_only_features.evidence: MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS=8000 enforced: read_file truncates (sandbox.py:191-193) and run_command truncates stdout/stderr (sandbox.py:230-236). Bounds what the subject must process per turn.
code_only_features.justification_quote: MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS = 8000  # tool output cap shown to the model (sandbox.py:49)
